title: Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Stand - 49-Inch Solid Brass - Assorted Free Standing Accessories Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Get more towel-drying space without drilling into your walls. This freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel stand keeps towels organized, separated, and within easy reach—ideal for everyday bathroom routines.

  • Maximize towel space in tight bathrooms: four pivoting swing arms spread towels out, then rotate in to save space.
  • No wall mounting needed: freestanding design places easily beside a vanity, tub, or shower.
  • Stays steady on the floor: heavy, weighted base is designed to help prevent tipping.
  • Built for damp environments: crafted from solid brass materials to resist rust and corrosion.
  • Coordinate your bathroom: part of the Assorted Free Standing Accessories collection and available in multiple designer finish options.

Specs & Details

  • Product type: Freestanding swing arm towel stand
  • Arms: 4 pivoting swing arms
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 12 in. x 49 in. x 9.25 in.
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
  • Assembly: Some assembly required
  • Assembled in the USA
